content.short: Besu is an enterprise-friendly Ethereum execution client.
content.description: Besu is an Ethereum execution client that joined the Hyperledger Foundation in August 2019. As an Apache 2.0-licensed, Java-based project, it provides a command line interface and JSON-RPC APIs for running, maintaining, debugging, and monitoring nodes across Ethereum networks. Besu supports smart contract development, deployment, and operations, and powers thousands of Ethereum nodes worldwide. It is open-source software developed under the Apache 2.0 license.
